main_body: timber-framed house with tiled pitched roof
top_band: terracotta/reddish-brown tiled roof slope with lighter ridge tiles at top, rows 2-43
evidence: A full 3/4 building showing a large pitched roof surface seen from above (rows 2-43, with a lighter ridge band at rows 3-8 and courses of tiles stepping down to the eave at row 42-43) overhanging a recessed front wall face (rows 44-78) with eave shadow at rows 44-45, inset doorway, and window.

style.evidence: The roof tiles have 5-6 distinct terracotta/brown shading steps with per-tile highlights and dark red-brown separators; plaster walls have multi-tone speckle grain; stone plinth, timber beams, shutters, and door all use dark material outlines and varied shading comparable in richness to the Beodeul house references.
